title: Bulk handling equipment - Ship unloader - Gantry mounted grab type - Code of practice for design, manufacture and erection, Part 3 Information to be supplied by purchaser and the manufacturer
clause_1_scope: 1,1 This standard ( Part 3) covers the require= merits of information to be supplied by the purchaser and the manufacturer relating to the design, manufacture and erection of gantry mounted grab type ship unloader provided with horizontal boom and grab-bucket.
clause_3_terminology: Part 3 Information to be supplied by purchaser and the manufacturer

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
